summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its transactional net asset values per share for multiple share classes as of June 30, 2026. The values ranged from $30.39 (Class D) to $36.34 (Class G/H). The filing also notes a July 2, 2026 redesignation of Class I Shares into Series 1-4. No merger, acquisition, tender, or strategic change is announced—this is a routine periodic NAV disclosure for a closed-end fund. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is purely informational with no special-situation event.
